results.controlIntent: a. Perform a risk assessment that includes: 1. Identifying threats to and vulnerabilities in the system; 2. Determining the likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, or destruction of the system, the information it processes, stores, or transmits, and any related information; and 3. Determining the likelihood and impact of adverse effects on individuals arising from the processing of personally identifiable information; b. Integrate risk assessment results and risk management decisions from the organization and mission or business process perspectives with system-level risk assessments; c. Record risk assessment results in [Selection: security and privacy plans; risk assessment report; [Assignment: organization-defined document]]; d. Review risk assessment results [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; e. Disseminate risk assessment results to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]; and f. Update the risk assessment [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] or when there are significant changes to the system, its environment of operation, or other conditions that may impact the security or privacy state of the system.

judgment.rationale: The getModelCard collector returned null for model "churn-predictor-v1" / endpoint "churn-predictor-endpoint", indicating that no model card exists. RA-3.v2 requires a substantive risk assessment that covers: (a) identification of threats and vulnerabilities, likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access/use/disclosure/disruption/modification/destruction, and adverse effects on individuals from PII processing; (b) integration of risk assessment results with organizational risk management; (c) recording of risk assessment results in a security/privacy plan, risk assessment report, or equivalent document; (d) periodic review of results; (e) dissemination to defined personnel/roles; and (f) updates upon significant changes or at defined frequency. The absence of a model card — the primary artifact that would document intended use, limitations, risk ratings, and evaluation details — means there is no evidence of any risk assessment having been performed, recorded, reviewed, disseminated, or maintained for this model. All sub-requirements of RA-3.v2 are therefore unmet.
